entities.summary: Daniel Nlandu Mayi was a Congolese Roman Catholic prelate. He served as an auxiliary bishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Kinshasa from 1999 to 2008. He was then appointed the Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Matadi from 2010 until his early resignation on 6 March 2021, due to declining health.
